components.name: Primary Aero Button
components.description: Canonical violet glossy action with a 44px minimum target.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:44px; padding:9px 18px; color:#fff; border:1px solid #6f399d; border-radius:4px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#bd8ce6,#a06ed2 48%,#7442a6 52%,#8754b8); box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.72),0 2px 6px rgba(57,27,85,.3); font:650 1rem 'Segoe UI',sans-serif; text-shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(40,14,65,.6); transition:filter 120ms,transform 120ms; cursor:pointer;} .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.08); transform:translateY(-1px);} .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:0; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,103,188,.9),0 0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.85);}

components.name: Secondary Aero Button
components.description: Pale water-glass action for navigation and recovery.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height:44px; padding:9px 18px; color:#0a2c4d; border:1px solid rgba(10,44,77,.24); border-radius:4px; background:linear-gradient(#fff,#e8f3fc 48%,#c8e3f5 52%,#eef8fd); box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.72),0 2px 6px rgba(10,44,77,.2); font:650 1rem 'Segoe UI',sans-serif; cursor:pointer;} .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color:#005a9e; transform:translateY(-1px);} .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:0; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,103,188,.9),0 0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.85);}

components.name: Aero Window
components.description: Signature square Vista chrome around an opaque reading bed.
components.html:
Portfolio — Project Explorer
Window content
components.css: .ds-window { overflow:hidden; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.78); border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.78); border-right:1px solid rgba(10,44,77,.36); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(10,44,77,.4); border-radius:0; background:rgba(226,241,249,.34); box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(3,25,43,.3),inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.85); font-family:'Segoe UI',sans-serif;} .ds-titlebar { padding:9px; color:#fff; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(122,195,238,.94),rgba(0,120,215,.9) 48%,rgba(0,78,140,.96) 52%,rgba(0,92,164,.96)); text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(4,20,36,.6);} .ds-window-body { padding:24px; color:#0a2c4d; background:#fafaf8;} .ds-window:focus-within { box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,103,188,.9),0 0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.85);}

components.name: Aero Content Card
components.description: Soft content surface inside the harder Vista frame.
components.css: .ds-card { display:grid; gap:8px; min-height:120px; padding:20px; color:#0a2c4d; text-decoration:none; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(10,44,77,.16); border-radius:8px; background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.88),rgba(232,243,252,.78)); box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(10,44,77,.14),inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.85); transition:transform 120ms;} .ds-card:hover { color:#005a9e; transform:translateY(-2px);} .ds-card:focus-visible { outline:0; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,103,188,.9),0 0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.85);} .ds-card span { color:#35506b;}

components.name: Aero Text Field
components.description: Simple recessed white field with explicit blue focus.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:grid; gap:8px; color:#0a2c4d; font:650 .82rem 'Segoe UI',sans-serif;} .ds-field { width:100%; padding:11px 12px; color:#0a2c4d; background:#fff; border:1px solid rgba(0,103,188,.35); border-radius:2px; font:400 1rem 'Segoe UI',sans-serif;} .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:0; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,103,188,.9),0 0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.85);}

narrative.overview: This is a sincere, functioning Windows Vista/7 Aero desktop, not a generic glass landing page and not an ironic retro skin. Window chrome, taskbar, Start menu, desktop icons, background atmosphere, focus, selection, and browser surfaces share one light-source-driven visual world. The period optimism stays intact while current accessibility, responsive behavior, and performance make it usable now.
keyCharacteristics: One real desktop/window metaphor built on real web routes
Sky, water, grass, gloss, and depth governed by one top-down light source
Tight, hard-edged Vista chrome around softer content surfaces
Opaque warm-white reading beds inside translucent window frames
Concentrated violet gloss for meaningful primary actions

rules.name: The Fill/Ink Rule
rules.body: Bright fills belong to surfaces and gradients. Only the darker ink twin carries text, icon strokes, or meaningful boundaries.

rules.name: The Border-Pair Rule
rules.body: A physical edge pairs a lit top/left line with a shaded bottom/right line; line weight alone does not create Aero depth.

rules.name: The Semilight Floor Rule
rules.body: Semilight is used only above 16px. Smaller type uses regular weight because fragile strokes read as broken rendering rather than polish.

rules.name: The No-Sideways Rule
rules.body: The page itself never scrolls horizontally; wide content scrolls inside its own bounded surface.

rules.name: The Refraction Rule
rules.body: Blur and shadow increase together. A high shadow without the corresponding refraction breaks the one-light-source model.

dos: Do extend the shared Astro shell, tokens, and canonical content schemas.
Do preserve direct links, Back/Forward, keyboard, print, and reduced-motion states as part of the design.
Do use right-sized local media with embedded origin or generation metadata.
Do keep precise Clockwork evidence legible inside the visual world.
donts: Don't introduce a client router, hidden full-page copies, or a second mobile shell.
Don't replace the established world with generic modern glassmorphism.
Don't add icon libraries, emoji, autoplaying project media, or remote font/CDN dependencies.
Don't place long-form type directly over moving or translucent imagery.
